name: Myah
source:
"Trust is never something given, you have to earn it. And you'll need to work hard if you want to earn mine."

Myah is the cool girl, and the only member of the group who seems to have common sense, so it seems difficult to understand how she ends up pulled into their chaos so often. But, under that hard shell and fiery temper, is secretly a heart of gold... but only for those she cares for.

Likes: Helping people, ancient medicine books, puzzles
Dislikes: Liars, chaos, large bodies of water

[From [url=https://glasswing-games.itch.io/home-is-where-the-heart-is]itch.io[/url]]
